name: StepGateDelay
description: Euclidean 1/16 gate into a tempo delay. Hold the pad to engage; the nearest 16th clock becomes relative step 0 (Ride909-style). X = Euclidean density among 16 steps (hits open the gate). Y = delay wet. SHAPE picks the per-step envelope: SQR, decaying SAW, RAMP, TRI, or EXP. Default delay is a dotted eighth. Feedback has high/low damp; low damp is on by default so repeats stay thin.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Overall wet while the pad is held

params.name: SHAPE
params.detail: Gate envelope: SQR, SAW (decay), RAMP, TRI, EXP
